title: Strength Of Feelings
paragraphs: “Imiya-chan, are you okay?”
Assistant was worried about Mole clinging to Luna-chan (temporary).
“I’m fine, but…”
“Imiya-chan, let’s dig the soil together… Playing with dirt is fun.”
“Filolials are really strange. It’s not like they’re aiming to eat you like Kou, but they’re still weird.”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”

Assistant and Rival were focusing on training the soldiers from various countries and the village slaves. Of course, the older sister was also taking care of the village slaves. Father and the cooks dispatched from the castle seemed to be busy preparing meals. The Filolial-sama were gathering food locally.
“The training of the soldiers is going pretty well. Naofumi, have you found Filo yet?”
Around noon, Ren and Itsuki came for lunch and asked Father.

“Not at all. There have been some kids with similar colors, but Motoyasu says they’re not the one. Of course, when she’s in her angel form, her hair and other features change, so that’s probably true.”
“Exactly! The colors are different from Filo-tan’s!”
“This is quite difficult. At this point, it’s fair to assume that there are some conditions even Motoyasu isn’t aware of.”
“That’s true. Considering how much we’ve searched and still haven’t found her, and if Luna-san isn’t the one, it’s safe to assume it’s condition-based.”
Itsuki said this while watching Luna-chan (temporary) play with Mole. Hmm, so that’s how it is?
“Oh my, Naofumi-chan, you’ve got it tough.”
“It’s not a big deal. Even if I don’t find Filo, we can still strengthen our forces. But this is for Motoyasu’s sake.”

The older sister peeked out from behind Father. She seemed quite familiar with him. Assistant spoke to Mole and petted Luna-chan (temporary). Assistant favors Rival the most, but that doesn’t mean he dislikes Filolial-sama. At that moment, Rival was walking dejectedly. The older sister watched Rival and then wrapped her arm around Father’s as she spoke.
“Shall we invite Gaelion-chan over tonight?”

“Why do you keep saying things like that?! Sadeena-san, I’d appreciate it if you could be a bit more restrained… I mean, it’s fine to have fun, but please limit it to me or Larsa-san and don’t involve the others, okay?”
“Oh my? I’m just inviting the girls who like Naofumi-chan.”
“Still, Sakura-chan is a bit much.”
“Hmm?”

Sakura-chan, who was absorbed in her meal, looked up, but Father smiled and told her not to worry. Indeed. This is not an appropriate topic during a meal. More than anything, I’m impressed by Father’s self-control.
“Oh? Naofumi-chan, do you dislike Sakura-chan because she’s a Filolial?”
“That’s not it… and I’m not falling for that.”
“Or is it because Sakura-chan is still young?”
“Sadeena-san.”
Father’s gaze grew slightly stern, but the older sister brushed it off as if it didn’t concern her. No, actually… her gaze felt a little scary too.
“Hey, Naofumi-chan, what would you do if someone who truly loves you from the bottom of their heart confessed to you?”
“Huh? No, I mean… Sadeena-san is… the person I like the most, so…”
Father’s anger dissipated. …Could this be what they call a weakness for someone you love? I want to show that kind of weakness to Filo-tan too!
“You know, Naofumi-chan. I don’t like seeing people who love you get hurt. So, if you can make them happy, I want to do fun things together.”
“Uh… well, that logic… It’s true that rejecting them would hurt, but…”
“Imiya-chan, just wait a little bit, okay? Naofumi-chan will make sure everything’s fine for you soon, I promise.”
“Sadeena-san!?”
The older sister waved at Mole. Father raised his voice in surprise, looking back and forth between the older sister and Mole.
“Ah… yes…”
Mole nodded, blushing.
“See, Naofumi-chan, what if Imiya-chan came on to you? Could you reject her?”
“Imiya-chan is just a child!” Father declared firmly.
But the older sister wouldn’t back down.
“No, Naofumi-chan. Imiya-chan is already an adult. Demi-humans and beastmen mature physically faster as their level increases.”
“Y-Yeah, but! I’m talking about what’s in my heart!”
“Of course, I’m not saying she looks young like Sakura-chan or Gaelion-chan. But by her race’s standards, Imiya-chan is already an adult. So, what would you do in that case?”

The older sister… how should I put this? She had that look—like when she was disciplining those who caused trouble in the village. I remember seeing the Filolial-sama fall victim to this tone and reflect on their actions.
“There will come a time when Imiya-chan strongly asks you not to treat her like a child, Naofumi-chan.”

Mole, still clinging to Luna-chan (temporary), placed her hand on her chest and looked straight at Father. …It looked as though Father was slowly being cornered. Is this part of the older sister’s scheme?
“Naofumi-chan, remember what you said the first time we did something fun together? You said you would love only me, but I want you to make everyone happy with your love.”
“That’s not… I meant that more as an ideal…”
“Oh? I took it literally, you know? I don’t think Naofumi-chan’s love is something that should only make one person happy.”
The older sister hugged Father from behind.
“Naofumi-chan is the Shield Hero who protects everyone, right? I’ll protect Naofumi-chan too. And everyone fights because they want to protect Naofumi-chan. You can’t forget that.”
“I know that, but…”

“I know, Naofumi-chan. Your protective instinct gets in the way of romance, and that’s fine. Even I would be troubled if Naofumi-chan approached someone too young out of lust. But if they’re already an adult, I don’t want you to reject them.”
“Um… could you take your flirting somewhere else? It looks like Imiya-san wants to join Sadeena-san’s little party too,” Itsuki spoke to Father with half-lidded eyes.
This guy really doesn’t know how to read the mood.
“Come on, Itsuki, think about Imiya-chan’s age before you say anything.”
“Imiya-san’s family already approved of her being with Naofumi-san, remember? She talked about it after reuniting with them, and she seemed willing even in front of her relatives.”
“Huh?”
“That’s right. We avoided talking about it in front of Naofumi, but her family has given their blessing.”
Father shot a piercing glare at Ren and Itsuki, making a grinding sound. The older sister clung to Father, acting all playful.
“Rather, Naofumi, who else would Imiya fall for besides you?”
“Exactly. Considering how rapidly Imiya’s body and mind have matured, there’s no way she wouldn’t go along with Sadeena-san’s suggestions, right?”
“Eh? But…”

“Look at the height of the women from Imiya’s race. She’s already the same height as them. Physically, she’s an adult. If you reject her, her family might resent you for it. You might be fine with that, Naofumi, but…”
“Can’t you just take it easy and do whatever you want after the world is at peace?”
“That goes for Ren, Itsuki, and even Motoyasu-kun too!” Father spoke firmly.
But Ren and Itsuki didn’t back down.

“The situation between us and Naofumi is completely different. For us, it’s just arranged matches set up by the kingdom. But for Naofumi, he’s someone who shared struggles and restored the place they lost. The strength of their feelings and the despair they’d feel if rejected are worlds apart.”
“Even in Motoyasu-san’s stories, the Naofumi-san from the first world did the same with that girl named Raphtalia, and they were lovers, weren’t they?”
Father fell silent. If he rejects her now… will Mole do something?
“Considering everything Naofumi has done with Sadeena, it’s not like he’s against beastmen, right?”
“That’s right~ Right now, Naofumi-chan is learning the joys of beastmen with Sasa-chan and me.”
“Eek!” The older sister said, blushing with embarrassment.
Ren and Itsuki looked exasperated at her reaction.
